reviewed_safe_statements.setups.py: Exact args equality against the two framework-owned registry literals returns the literal, never arbitrary exception text.
reviewed_safe_statements.editor.py: AuthoringError guidance is audited in the console contract; its ReviewView proposal is projected through safe_review. Native draft diagnostics omit Pydantic input snapshots. Whole SourceDiagnostic serialization carries framework validation/syntax codes, messages and source locations from definition.source; arbitrary native exception objects are not serialized.
reviewed_safe_statements.app.py: Audited typed operation guidance and UUID carriers plus fixed code-specific recovery messages; provenance is recorded in the console contract. The admission_not_attempted response forwards the same reviewed code-filtered message plus a boolean marker.
reviewed_safe_statements.example_bundle.py: Only WorkspaceRefused is forwarded: workspace.ensure_owned_directory constructs fixed permission/ownership guidance from explicit paths and stat fields. Raw OSError uses console_error_message; no arbitrary exception text or custom class name is forwarded. The aliased message in the reviewed AddTaskRefused raise comes only from that typed branch or safe category; left adds fixed partial-copy guidance plus the explicit target path.
reviewed_safe_statements.package_mounts.py: SandboxProfile.device_paths and _canonical_path raise only fixed framework guidance plus the operator-declared path, including missing-GPU recovery instructions. Only str(error) is forwarded; nested causes and tracebacks are not rendered.
reviewed_safe_statements.setup_routes.py: SetupRefused.message already uses safe projection; TaskReferenceFinding is fixed framework finding guidance from candidate_compatibility, not a native exception model. The now-visible content alias and finding dump are exact reviewed statements.
